recipes.title: Lamb Arayes with Tahini Yogurt Sauce

items.i: olive oil, plus more for cooking

steps: Grate the onion and squeeze out the liquid in a clean kitchen towel.
Mix the onion, garlic, parsley, cilantro, all the spices and the olive oil, then work it thoroughly into the lamb.
Cut the pitas in half, stuff each pocket with the lamb mixture and drizzle generously with olive oil.
Sear meat-side down in a heavy pan over medium heat for 1–2 minutes until crusted, then toast the bread sides until golden and crisp.
Finish in a 350°F (175°C) oven for 10–15 minutes until the meat reaches about 155°F (68°C).
Stir together all the sauce ingredients, adjusting to taste, and serve with the arayes.
recipes.notes: Recipe amounts are the creator's; macros are estimated per serving with sauce.
